reading: A BBC News investigation has revealed that Bassam al-Hassan, a former high-ranking Syrian officer, is being bankrolled and safeguarded by US and Lebanese authorities.
Hassan, who supervised Syria's chemical weapons program and advised former President Bashar al-Assad, is being hosted in Lebanon following the Assad regime's collapse in 2024.
The investigation, conducted by the BBC and NPR, found Hassan was allowed to stay due to an agreement with the FBI and other US and Lebanese entities.
His willingness to provide intelligence, particularly concerning the 2012 seizure of American journalist Austin Tice, underpins this arrangement.
It was previously reported that Tice's capture was a planned operation, with Hassan involved in the leadership structure.
Officials from Syria's new government seek Hassan's return for trial, but US authorities prefer he remains in Lebanon, leaving Damascus with limited recourse.
The Tice family’s spokesperson said that, if the findings were true, using US taxes to support Hassan was offensive.
He asserted that this constitutes assistance to a wanted war criminal’s escape and called for Hassan to be returned for trial.
Sources confirm Hassan receives funds from US authorities via an intermediary, making the payments harder to track despite his US sanctions.
However, individuals involved in the Tice investigation express concerns that Hassan's deal may continue for an unspecified duration with little discernible progress.
He is considered valuable for his alleged knowledge of Tice's fate, Syria's chemical weapons program, and its military ties with Iran.
Though Hassan told investigators Tice was executed and suggested a burial site, searches found nothing, casting doubt on his account's validity.
Questions remain over the thoroughness of the search, with sources suggesting US authorities halted digging prematurely.
The investigation also found that other Syrian officials connected to the Tice case had apparently found refuge abroad.

vocabulary.definition: To provide financial support for someone or something, often in a significant way.
To observe and direct the execution of a task, activity, or group, ensuring it is done correctly.
Organizations, institutions, or groups with a distinct and independent existence.
The action of forcibly taking something or someone, often by legal authority or by force.
To form the basis, support, or foundation for something, strengthening its existence or validity.
The hierarchical arrangement of individuals in positions of authority and decision-making within an organization.
Having few available options or inadequate means to obtain remedy, assistance, or legal redress.
To state a fact or belief confidently and forcefully, often in the face of contradiction.
To be or be considered as; to form or make up a particular part of something.
A person who acts as a link between two parties to facilitate an agreement, communication, or transaction.

entries.ja: 誰かや何かに対して、しばしば多額の財政的支援を提供すること。
entries.ko: 어떤 사람이나 무언가에 대해 상당한 방식으로 재정적 지원을 제공하는 것.
entries.zh-Hans: 为某人或某事提供经济支持，通常是以一种重要的、大笔的方式。
entries.es: Proporcionar apoyo financiero a alguien o algo, a menudo de manera significativa.
entries.pt-BR: Fornecer apoio financeiro a alguém ou algo, geralmente de forma significativa.
entries.fr: Fournir un soutien financier à quelqu'un ou à quelque chose, souvent de manière significative.
entries.de: Jemandem oder etwas finanzielle Unterstützung zukommen zu lassen, oft in erheblichem Umfang.

entries.ja: タスク、活動、またはグループの実行を観察し指揮し、それが正しく行われることを確認すること。
entries.ko: 작업, 활동 또는 집단의 실행을 관찰하고 지시하여 정확하게 수행되도록 하는 것.
entries.zh-Hans: 观察并指导某项任务、活动或某个团队的执行，确保其正确完成。
entries.es: Observar y dirigir la ejecución de una tarea, actividad o grupo, asegurándose de que se realice correctamente.
entries.pt-BR: Observar e direcionar a execução de uma tarefa, atividade ou grupo, garantindo que seja realizada corretamente.
entries.fr: Observer et diriger l'exécution d'une tâche, d'une activité ou d'un groupe, en s'assurant que cela est fait correctement.
entries.de: Die Ausführung einer Aufgabe, Tätigkeit oder Gruppe zu beobachten und zu leiten, um sicherzustellen, dass sie korrekt ausgeführt wird.

entries.ja: 独自の独立した存在を持つ組織、機関、またはグループ。
entries.ko: 독자적이고 독립적인 존재를 가진 조직, 기관 또는 단체.
entries.zh-Hans: 具有独特且独立存在的组织、机构或团体。
entries.es: Organizaciones, instituciones o grupos con una existencia distinta e independiente.
entries.pt-BR: Organizações, instituições ou grupos com uma existência distinta e independente.
entries.fr: Des organisations, des institutions ou des groupes qui ont une existence distincte et indépendante.
entries.de: Organisationen, Institutionen oder Gruppen mit einer eigenständigen und unabhängigen Existenz.

entries.ja: しばしば法的権限や武力によって、何かまたは誰かを強制的に奪い取る行為。
entries.ko: 종종 법적 권한이나 물리적인 힘으로 어떤 것이나 누군가를 강제로 빼앗는 행위.
entries.zh-Hans: 通过法律授权或武力，强行夺取某物或某人的行为。
entries.es: La acción de tomar por la fuerza algo o a alguien, a menudo por autoridad legal o por coacción.
entries.pt-BR: A ação de tomar algo ou alguém à força, muitas vezes por autoridade legal ou por coação.
entries.fr: L'action de prendre de force quelque chose ou quelqu'un, souvent par autorité légale ou par la contrainte.
entries.de: Die Handlung, etwas oder jemanden gewaltsam an sich zu nehmen, oft durch rechtliche Autorität oder Zwang.

entries.ja: 何かの基礎、支え、または基盤を形成し、その存在や妥当性を強化すること。
entries.ko: 어떤 것의 기초, 지지 또는 기반을 형성하여 그 존재나 타당성을 강화하는 것.
entries.zh-Hans: 构成某事的基础、支撑或根基，从而巩固其存在或有效性。
entries.es: Formar la base, el apoyo o el fundamento de algo, fortaleciendo su existencia o validez.
entries.pt-BR: Formar a base, o apoio ou o fundamento para algo, fortalecendo sua existência ou validade.
entries.fr: Former la base, le soutien ou le fondement de quelque chose, renforçant son existence ou sa validité.
entries.de: Die Grundlage, Unterstützung oder Basis für etwas zu bilden und somit dessen Existenz oder Gültigkeit zu stärken.

entries.ja: 組織内で権威と意思決定の立場にある個人の階層的配置。
entries.ko: 조직 내에서 권한과 의사결정 위치에 있는 개인들의 계층적 배열.
entries.zh-Hans: 组织内具有权力与决策地位的个体之间的层级安排。
entries.es: La disposición jerárquica de individuos en posiciones de autoridad y toma de decisiones dentro de una organización.
entries.pt-BR: O arranjo hierárquico de indivíduos em posições de autoridade e tomada de decisões dentro de uma organização.
entries.fr: L'organisation hiérarchique des individus occupant des postes d'autorité et de prise de décision au sein d'une organisation.
entries.de: Die hierarchische Anordnung von Personen in Autoritäts- und Entscheidungspositionen innerhalb einer Organisation.

entries.ja: 救済、援助、または法的救済を得るための利用可能な選択肢が少ない、または不十分な手段しか持たないこと。
entries.ko: 구제, 지원 또는 법적 보상을 얻을 수 있는 선택지가 거의 없거나 불충분한 수단을 가지는 것.
entries.zh-Hans: 获得补救、援助或法律救济的可用选项很少或手段不足。
entries.es: Tener pocas opciones disponibles o medios inadecuados para obtener un remedio, asistencia o reparación legal.
entries.pt-BR: Ter poucas opções disponíveis ou meios inadequados para obter reparação, assistência ou recurso legal.
entries.fr: Avoir peu d'options disponibles ou des moyens inadéquats pour obtenir un recours, une assistance ou une réparation légale.
entries.de: Wenige verfügbare Optionen oder unzureichende Mittel zu haben, um Abhilfe, Unterstützung oder rechtlichen Beistand zu erhalten.

entries.ja: しばしば矛盾に直面しても、事実や信念を自信を持って力強く述べること。
entries.ko: 종종 반대에도 불구하고 사실이나 믿음을 자신감 있고 단호하게 진술하는 것.
entries.zh-Hans: 自信而有力地陈述事实或信念，即使面对反驳。
entries.es: Declarar un hecho o una creencia con confianza y fuerza, a menudo frente a la contradicción.
entries.pt-BR: Declarar um fato ou uma crença com confiança e força, muitas vezes diante de contradições.
entries.fr: Énoncer un fait ou une conviction avec assurance et force, souvent face à la contradiction.
entries.de: Eine Tatsache oder Überzeugung selbstbewusst und nachdrücklich darlegen, oft im Angesicht eines Widerspruchs.

entries.ja: あるものとして存在すること、あるいは見なされること。何かの特定の部分を形成したり構成したりすること。
entries.ko: 어떤 것으로 존재하거나 간주되는 것. 어떤 것의 특정 부분을 형성하거나 구성하는 것.
entries.zh-Hans: 是或被认为是；形成或构成某事物的特定部分。
entries.es: Ser o considerarse como; formar o componer una parte particular de algo.
entries.pt-BR: Ser ou ser considerado como; formar ou compor uma parte específica de algo.
entries.fr: Être ou être considéré comme ; former ou constituer une partie particulière de quelque chose.
entries.de: Als etwas sein oder betrachtet werden; einen bestimmten Teil von etwas bilden oder ausmachen.

entries.ja: 合意、コミュニケーション、または取引を促進するために、二者間の連絡役として行動する人。
entries.ko: 합의, 의사소통 또는 거래를 촉진하기 위해 두 당사자 사이의 연결 고리 역할을 하는 사람.
entries.zh-Hans: 在两方之间充当联系人，以促成协议、沟通或交易的人。
entries.es: Una persona que actúa como enlace entre dos partes para facilitar un acuerdo, comunicación o transacción.
entries.pt-BR: Uma pessoa que atua como elo entre duas partes para facilitar um acordo, comunicação ou transação.
entries.fr: Une personne qui agit comme un lien entre deux parties pour faciliter un accord, une communication ou une transaction.
entries.de: Eine Person, die als Verbindung zwischen zwei Parteien fungiert, um eine Einigung, Kommunikation oder Transaktion zu erleichtern.

review.method: Codex multilingual editorial update; unchanged definitions retained after review of their use in the revised reading; no paid translation or new independent model review
